wiki.title: Jason Nazarenko
wiki.extract: Jason Nazarenko is an American politician from Arkansas. In 2024, he was elected to represent the 4th district in the Arkansas House of Representatives, which contains Marion County and parts of Baxter County. A Republican, he is retired from the military. He is a Baptist. He lives in Cotter, Arkansas. He and his wife have two adult children.
